                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          MAKE-TOROIDAL-SURFACE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • X
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Y
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Z
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • MAJOR-R
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • MINOR-R
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Create a torus centered at (x, y, z) with the given radii.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • major-r distance from center to tube center
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • minor-r radius of the tube

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (make-toroidal-surface 0 0 0 20 5)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See also: make-spherical-surface

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            MAKE-TORUS

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • MAJOR-RADIUS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • MINOR-RADIUS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Create a torus (donut shape) with the given radii.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • major-radius distance from center to tube center (positive double-float)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • minor-radius radius of the tube (positive double-float)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MAKE-TRIHEDRON

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • &KEY
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ORIGIN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • NORMAL
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • X-DIRECTION
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Creates a trihedron AIS object.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                origin is the position, normal is the Z direction, x-direction defines the X axis. All are 3-element coordinate lists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Example: (with-viewer (v) (let ((ctx (ais-create-context v)) (tri (make-trihedron))) (ais-display ctx tri)))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                MAKE-VEC2D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Y

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MAKE-VERTEX

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • X

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MAKE-VIEWER

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Creates a new viewer with a 3D view.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The viewer is automatically finalized for garbage collection. Uses with-viewer for guaranteed cleanup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Example: (let ((v (make-viewer))) (fit-all v) (free-viewer v))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        MAKE-WIRE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • &REST
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • EDGES
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Join one or more edges into a wire (connected edge sequence).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Returns: a wire shape, or nil if no edges are provided. All edges should be connected end-to-end to form a valid wire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          (let ((e1 (make-edge 0 0 10 0))
      (e2 (make-edge 10 0 10 10)))
  (make-wire e1 e2))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          MAP-SHAPE-SUBSHAPES

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • SHAPE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • TYPE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • &KEY
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • STOP-AT
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Collect all subshapes of shape matching the given type keyword.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • type keyword in (:compound, :compsolid, :solid, :shell, :face, :wire, :edge, :vertex, :shape)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • stop-at optional type keyword at which to stop recursion (default :shape, meaning recurse to leaves)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (let ((box (make-box 10 20 30)))
    (map-shape-subshapes box :face))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See also: count-shape-subshapes, dump-shape

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            MATERIAL-PRESET-LIST

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Returns the list of available material preset keyword names.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                MSAA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • VIEW
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Returns the current MSAA sample count for view.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: (with-viewer (v) (set-msaa v 4) (msaa v)) => 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  MUST-BE-RESIZED

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • V
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Notifies the view that its window size has changed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Call this when the viewer's window is resized so the projection matrix is recalculated.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Example: (let ((v (make-viewer))) (must-be-resized v) (free-viewer v))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    NAMED-COLOR

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Looks up the (R G B) triple for a named color keyword.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        (named-color :red)
  => (1.0 0.0 0.0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      NAMED-COLOR-EXISTS-P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • NAME
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Returns t if name is a known named color keyword.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          (named-color-exists-p :red)
  => T
  (named-color-exists-p :nonexistent)
  => NIL
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NORMALIZE-COLOR

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • COLOR
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alias for color-rgb — returns (R G B) from any color representation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            (normalize-color :red)
  => (1.0 0.0 0.0)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          OFFSET-SHAPE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • SHAPE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • OFFSET-DISTANCE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • &KEY
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • JOIN
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Offset a 3D solid or face by a given distance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Positive offset-distance offsets outward, negative inward. join is one of :arc (default), :tangent, or :intersection, controlling how adjacent offset surfaces are joined.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Returns: a new shape, or nil if shape is null.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (offset-shape (make-box 10 10 10) 3.0)
  (offset-shape (make-box 10 10 10) -2.0 :join :tangent)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            See also: offset-wire, shell-shape

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            OFFSET-WIRE

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • WIRE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • OFFSET-DISTANCE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Offset a 2D planar wire by a given distance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Positive offset-distance offsets outward, negative inward.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Returns: a new wire shape, or nil if wire is null.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (let* ((e1 (make-edge 0 0 10 0))
         (e2 (make-edge 10 0 10 10))
         (e3 (make-edge 10 10 0 10))
         (e4 (make-edge 0 10 0 0))
         (wire (make-wire e1 e2 e3 e4)))
    (offset-wire wire 3.0))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              See also: offset-shape

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PAN-CAMERA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • VIEW
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • DX
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • DY
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pans the camera by dx and dy in screen coordinates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Example: (with-viewer (v) (pan-camera v 10.0 -5.0))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                PERSPECTIVE-P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • VIEW
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Returns t if view is using perspective projection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: (with-viewer (v) (set-perspective v t) (perspective-p v)) => t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • EXTERNAL FUNCTION

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  POINT-IN-SOLID-P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • POINT
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • SHAPE
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Test whether a point is inside, outside, or on a solid shape.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    point -- 3D point as (x y z) shape -- a solid shape

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Returns: :inside, :outside, :on, or nil if classification fails.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Example:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (let ((b (make-box 10 10 10)))
    (point-in-solid-p '(5 5 5) b))
  => :inside

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    See also: classify-point-in-solid
